text_en: 1. The market opened higher and trended lower throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index falling more than 3% in the afternoon. The AI comic drama concept surged against the trend, with many stocks hitting the daily limit, including Omnijoi, Wintime Holding, Hengdian Film & TV, and China Film. Pig farming stocks rose collectively, with Jinxinnong and Tech-Bank Food hitting the daily limit. The banking sector continued to strengthen, with Bank of Qingdao, Bank of Jiangsu, Bank of Nanjing, Bank of Chengdu and Bank of Hangzhou all hitting record highs. On the downside, computing power hardware led the declines, with Shengyi Technology, Dongshan Precision and Wus Printed Circuit hitting the daily limit, T&S Communications falling more than 10%, and Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink falling more than 8%. Stocks broadly declined, with more than 4,700 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the red, and turnover today at 1.67 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.59%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.05%, and the ChiNext Index fell 3.32%. 2.
